Hi Emily —

Thanks for sending the LOI highlights. Quick answers up front:
- Close date we’ll record: 2027-04-15 (we can shift if your approval calendar moves earlier).
- Stage we plan to set in SFDC: "Commit — Legal & Procurement" while docs are in procurement review.
- Latency SLA: Redwood can meet the latency target outlined in the demo on the current model selection; I’ll loop in Vivek for final capacity signoff.

Vivek / Monica — can one of you attach the SFDC evidence snapshot to this thread (CSV export showing CRE-2027-014 current stage and ARR) and confirm there’s no ticket blocking reserved capacity for mid-April? Sales Ops requested that evidence for their packet by EOD Tuesday.

Emily — once we post the snapshot to SFDC (and you confirm your approval window), I’ll update the record and set the stage to the Commit label so your ops team sees alignment. If anything changes on your side, reply with the updated approval date and we’ll mirror it.

Best,
